close_reason: Low impact: all callers either map the String into io::Error/JmapError or just check .is_err(). No caller matches on specific validation failure. Typed error would add complexity for no external benefit.
description:
kith-attach/src/lib.rs:33: pub fn validate_blob_id(id: &str) -> Result<(), String>

Returning String as the error type from a public library function prevents callers from matching on specific failure reasons (empty, too long, invalid char, starts-with-dot) without string parsing.

Fix: introduce a BlobIdError enum (or at minimum a newtype) and return Result<(), BlobIdError>. This gives callers structured access to the rejection reason.
title: validate_blob_id returns Result<(), String> — use typed error
